title: Dispatch start marker (dispatch-start)
description: Appended by every dispatched project-defined agent (except pipeline-coordinator and the terminal change-grader) as its first tool call. Forms half of the dispatch-event contract: a dispatch-start for (req_id, agent) with no subsequent substantive record from the same agent is the deterministic truncation signal, without requiring any runtime-specific signal. Substantive records are the closed enum {build-pass, build-failure, review-feedback, prd-entry, design-block, consultation-response}; consultation-request, design-doc-autofix, and dispatch-start itself are explicitly NOT substantive. The pipeline-coordinator is exempt — its output is a routing recommendation in the response stream, not a substantive .scratch/ record, so 'start without substantive record' would always fire. The change-grader is exempt — it is the terminal advisory hop; nothing routes on its grader-features and grader-verdict records, so the truncation signal has no consumer. The contract is prompt-side discipline; there is no runtime enforcement.

author.description: The dispatched agent's name. One of the three core specialists, or a roster reviewer — a floor reviewer (code-quality-reviewer, test-reviewer, security-reviewer, doc-reviewer) or a project-declared extra reviewer via scripts/layout.toml [harness] extra_reviewers; every roster reviewer carries the dispatch-start contract. pipeline-coordinator and change-grader are intentionally omitted (exempt from the contract per the description above). The roster is enforced by the doctor, not by this schema; the pattern only shape-checks the name (same convention as review-feedback.author).

responding_to.description: 1-indexed line numbers in .scratch/handoff.jsonl pointing to the record(s) this dispatch is responding to. Empty array is invalid — every dispatch responds to at least one prior record (a prd-entry for system-design-expert and feature-implementer, a build-pass for reviewers, a review-feedback for the implementer after changes_requested, a consultation-request for the consulted specialist, a design-block with supersedes_record_at for re-triage). For the very first dispatch in a fresh feature context where no prior record exists, set to [0] as a sentinel meaning 'fresh feature, no inbound record.'
